# Modular plugin delivery — 15 October 2026

Plugin **0.1.8** uses `ArcaneLocalBridge.rbxmx`: one enabled Script with thirteen child ModuleScripts. The version distinguishes this delivery and identity scheme from the earlier single-script plugin. Each source remains limited to 199,999 bytes while the combined hierarchy can grow beyond that bound. Builder and daemon share the 4 MiB artifact bound, including XML CDATA expansion. The XML `.rbxm` compatibility alias remains available. The builder's in-memory factory representation exists only for offline VM fixtures; no single-script `.lua` plugin is emitted or packaged.

The builder, installer, daemon import-preparation hash, product doctor and local/Windows release requirements now agree on the preferred modular artifact. Deterministic build verification still covers all normalized sources and both XML artifacts. Windows checkout rules preserve XML bytes. Check mode rejects a leftover `.lua`; rebuilding removes only a recognized generated legacy bundle, and release creation refuses a mixed delivery.

Runtime continuity uses the `arcane-plugin-source-v1` identity, separately from the XML file checksum. The builder and daemon share an ordered source inventory. Main hashes its own loaded Source and all thirteen actual child ModuleScripts, rejecting unknown, missing, duplicate, nested or incorrectly typed children. The daemon independently verifies every packaged source descriptor and recomputes that identity. This prevents the old main-script hash from being compared to an XML container hash and makes child-source changes visible to continuity checks.

The installer verifies the complete build before changing a selected folder, preflights all known filenames, preserves unrelated files, keeps backups outside the active plugin directory, and migrates recognized legacy aliases. Repeating an identical installation reports unchanged. Installer acceptance uses disposable folders only.

Validation includes type checking, independent XML reconstruction and hierarchy checks, aggregate source above the single-script bound, legacy cleanup, installer migration and refusal paths, import hash checks and release fixtures. The full standalone plugin suite with pinned Luau 0.742 runtime/compiler/analyzer passes 389/389 with no skips. That includes running the actual Main identity function against the builder, source changes, BOM/CRLF normalization and invalid hierarchies. Broader application/release verification is recorded separately after execution.

Actual native Studio loading, the connected mesh-upload path, packaged customer acceptance, application signing and the overall product goal remain open. No Studio operation or real plugin installation is part of this change. SSH commit signatures are separate from Windows application signing.
